description: This file defines the Config class within the OrangeHRM system, managing configuration constants, static methods for configuration handling, and integration with external configuration files.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class providing static methods and constants for managing system configuration within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes configuration by loading external configs if not already initialized.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by name, with optional default.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a specified value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new configuration parameters into existing configs.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the system configuration is installed by attempting to load the config file.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Returns the Conf object, loading it from file if necessary.
